name: Core VLSI & Semiconductor Engineering
description: Industry core roles in IC design, FPGA/ASIC verification, semiconductor device modeling, and embedded hardware architectures.

name: Power Systems, Smart Grid & Renewable Energy
description: Industry and utility core roles in smart grid operations, renewable energy integration, power system protection, and EV drivetrain charging.

name: Higher Studies & Research in Electrical Sciences
description: Preparation for Ph.D. / MS research tracks, funded academic lab projects, international research fellowships, and faculty lab exploration.

name: Software Engineering & Data Science Transition
description: Cross-branch transition to software development, machine learning, and systems engineering leveraging CS minor courses and algorithmic electives.

name: Public Services & Competitive Examinations
description: Civil Services & Competitive Examinations (UPSC CSE/State PSC). NOTE: Core General Studies subjects (Polity, History, Economy, Geography, International Relations) lie outside the institutional engineering course catalogue. Preparation must be driven by weekly roadmap milestones and open educational resources, while satisfying basic degree requirements.

name: Deep-Tech Entrepreneurship & Venture Development
description: Building deep-tech hardware/software startups, prototype commercialization, and incubation balancing academic obligations.

name: Process Metallurgist (Iron & Steelmaking / Primary Metals)
description: Lead plant operations, DRI/H2 reduction decarbonization, and process control in integrated steelworks and metal extraction plants (Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL).

name: Advanced Materials R&D (Aerospace, Defense & HEAs)
description: R&D engineer developing high-entropy alloys, structural metamaterials, light alloy components, and high-temperature coatings (DRDO, ISRO, DMRL).

name: Biomaterials & Medical Device Engineer
description: Design biodegradable metallic orthopedic implants, bone-regeneration scaffolds, and biocompatible medical devices.

name: Energy Materials & Battery Technologies
description: Design advanced materials for lithium-ion battery electrodes, solid electrolytes, thermoelectric devices, and hydrogen storage systems.

name: Higher Studies & Research in Materials Science
description: Preparation for Ph.D. and MS research in premier international institutes and IIT laboratories in metallurgy and materials science.

name: UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE)
description: Undergraduate preparation for UPSC Civil Services Examination (IAS/IPS/IFS) balancing B.Tech curriculum and career fallback.

name: Student Startup Founder
description: B.Tech EE or MME student at IIT Bhubaneswar building a venture during the degree (idea to first pilot/revenue), any year Sem 1-8.

name: Software Development Engineer (SDE) Career Track
description: Non-core career track for EE/MME students: programming, DSA, CS fundamentals, system design, portfolio projects, hackathons and interview preparation alongside the B.Tech degree.

name: Data Analyst Career Track
description: Non-core career track for EE/MME students: spreadsheets, SQL, Python/pandas, statistics, BI dashboards, portfolio projects, data hackathons and analyst interview preparation.

name: AI & Machine Learning Engineer Career Track
description: Non-core career track for EE/MME students: maths and Python foundations, classical ML, deep learning, projects, specialisation and research exposure, with competitions and hackathons.

name: MBA / Management Pathway (CAT)
description: Core-to-MBA pathway: QA, DILR and VARC preparation, profile building and B-school shortlisting alongside the B.Tech degree. Detailed prep tools live in the Core-to-MBA module.
